artifacts.summary: 9-phase plan fixing 20 agent files (22 edit sites) to carry a concrete inline terminal status, extracting the canonical 8-value return-meta vocabulary into a shared sourced library, and adding lint Check E as the regression guard.

memory_candidates.content: When a lint enforces a documented vocabulary over agent/contract markdown bodies, the prohibited value almost always appears legitimately in the file's own MUST-NOT prose (e.g. 'Use status value "completed" (triggers Claude stop behavior)' appears in ~30 agent bodies). Match the quoted key/value PAIR ("status"\s*:\s*"completed") rather than the bare word, and add an explicit negative test fixture carrying the MUST-NOT prose plus a conformant value -- otherwise the guard fails precisely the files that already document the rule correctly. This mirrors lint-agent-contracts.sh's Check F window-and-key-set precedent over a loose grep.
